name: corpus-11-tools
description: Stable Corpus 11.x analysis toolkit with bounded routing, 49 capability wrappers, provenance, non-regression checks, an experiment arena, and a project-yield gate.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded analysis, audit, experiments, and provenance
interface.longDescription: A stable plugin package implementing the Corpus 11.x operational graph as focused skills. It routes only relevant capabilities, preserves provenance and user agency, tests claims against rival models and protocol changes, and keeps experimental results distinct from deployment or general validity.
